Description: Variables

Rule_Name: S_req = S_dataset + S_model + S_checkpoint + S_temp + S_logs_cache
Description: Each term is required persistent or peak-resident storage capacity
Input_Source: Derived by decomposing required storage into distinct data objects and adding only non-overlapping capacity requirements.
Condition: MLPerf Storage workload definitions; NeMo checkpoint documentation
Operator: MLPerf Storage workload/capacity definitions; NeMo checkpointing
Threshold_Value: Terms represent distinct storage occupancy and retention policy is known.
Output_Decision: Peak temporary occupancy must be considered; do not double count shared files/copies.

Rule_Name: S_dataset = stored bytes of required dataset representations and required copies
Description: Raw/encoded/transformed dataset bytes; replicas/shards
Input_Source: Direct measurement or manifest aggregation; no universal compression factor.
Operator: MLPerf Storage workload descriptions
Output_Decision: Nominal dataset size may differ from on-disk footprint.

Rule_Name: S_checkpoint = N_retained × S_checkpoint_each
Description: N_retained = retained checkpoints; S_checkpoint_each = actual checkpoint footprint
Input_Source: Derived from retention policy and actual checkpoint footprint. NeMo confirms checkpoint state includes model/optimizer/metadata and may be sharded.
Condition: NeMo AutoModel; MLPerf Storage checkpoint workload
Operator: Checkpointing section; MLPerf Storage checkpoint benchmark
Output_Decision: Different checkpoints may differ in size; use actual maximum/expected sizes.

Rule_Name: S_temp = peak_temporary_disk_occupancy
Description: Peak simultaneous temporary files/intermediates
Input_Source: Measured or instrumented peak disk occupancy, not cumulative bytes written.
Operator: Workload-specific
Threshold_Value: Temporary files have identifiable lifetime and overlap.
Output_Decision: Requires representative concurrency and cleanup behavior.

Rule_Name: BW_read_req = D_read / T_window
Description: D_read = bytes that must be read during window; T_window = allowed time
Input_Source: Derived from workload data consumption and target processing interval.
Operator: Metrics / workload benchmark methodology
Threshold_Value: D_read and T_window use the same scope and concurrency.
Output_Decision: Caching and compression can reduce physical storage reads; use observed path.

Rule_Name: BW_write_req = D_write / T_window
Description: D_write = bytes that must be durably written; T_window = allowed completion time
Input_Source: Derived from checkpoint/log/intermediate write volume and time objective.
Condition: NVIDIA GDS metrics; MLPerf Storage checkpoint benchmark
Operator: Checkpoint benchmark metrics
Threshold_Value: Durability semantics and completion point are defined.
Output_Decision: Write-back cache may make apparent throughput differ from durable throughput.
Rule_Type: Derived Formula — project approval where used as hard constraint

Rule_Name: IOPS_req = N_ops / T
Description: N_ops = required I/O operations; T = observation/requirement interval
Input_Source: Derived from operation count and required completion rate.
Operator: IOPS definition; random/sequential I/O section
Threshold_Value: Operation size and read/write mix are preserved.
Output_Decision: IOPS is meaningful only with request size, queue depth and latency context.

Rule_Name: L_req = maximum acceptable I/O completion time attributable to storage
Description: Measured storage latency or workload SLA component
Input_Source: Not a universal formula; threshold is obtained from workload/SLA or benchmark context.
Operator: Latency definitions and workload metrics
Threshold_Value: Storage component of end-to-end latency can be isolated.
Output_Decision: Do not substitute storage latency for end-to-end application latency.

Rule_Name: min(BW_storage, BW_link, BW_path) >= BW_demand
Description: BW values are comparable bottleneck-stage bandwidths
Input_Source: Derived bottleneck inequality from serial data-path capacity; NVIDIA documents matching storage/NIC/PCIe path bandwidth and direct GDS paths.
Operator: 6.1 Platform Performance Suitability
Threshold_Value: Bandwidth terms refer to the same path and direction.
Output_Decision: This is a capacity abstraction; it does not replace compatibility/topology rules.

Rule_Name: Storage_bottleneck = TRUE only when profile evidence attributes target-performance loss to storage
Description: Storage metrics + application wait/idle evidence
Input_Source: Diagnostic rule, not a numeric threshold. MLPerf Storage demonstrates accelerator starvation when storage cannot supply data at workload demand.
Operator: Training benchmark description; profiling metrics
Output_Decision: High storage utilization alone is insufficient.

Rule_Name: BW_node_req = Σ_i BW_i across concurrent storage consumers
Description: Per-process/rank/stream storage demand
Input_Source: Derived aggregation for concurrent consumers sharing one storage path.
Operator: Training workload / client-node context
Threshold_Value: Consumers are concurrent and demands refer to same storage endpoint/path.
Output_Decision: Do not assume each consumer has identical demand.

Rule_Name: BW_cluster_req = Σ_j BW_node_j
Description: Per-node storage demand for nodes concurrently accessing shared/distributed storage
Input_Source: Derived aggregation over actual node access pattern.
Operator: Client nodes; aggregate Read B/W/Write B/W
Threshold_Value: Node demands are measured/estimated under comparable workload conditions.
Output_Decision: Scaling may be non-linear due to contention, metadata, network and filesystem effects.

Rule_Name: T_ckpt = S_ckpt / BW_write_sustained
Description: S_ckpt = bytes written; BW_write_sustained = sustained durable write bandwidth
Input_Source: Direct relationship between checkpoint size and sustained write bandwidth; MLPerf Storage notes duration is operationally meaningful and bandwidth is the normalized view.
Operator: Checkpoint benchmark metrics
Threshold_Value: Bandwidth represents the durable completion path.
Output_Decision: Real write duration can include metadata/fsync/coordination overhead.

Rule_Name: T_restore = S_ckpt / BW_read_sustained
Description: S_ckpt = checkpoint bytes; BW_read_sustained = sustained read bandwidth
Input_Source: Derived from checkpoint size and sustained restore read bandwidth.
Operator: Checkpoint benchmark metrics
Threshold_Value: Read path and checkpoint layout are comparable.
Output_Decision: Does not include model initialization or non-storage recovery work.
